messages:
IncidentBot: [P0] 09:12 UTC — Routing service: sudden misroute spike observed in us-west-2 -> ~30% of requests incorrectly routed to eu models. Auto-escalation triggered.
PagerDuty: Paging Anya (oncall) — assigned 09:12.
Anya: Taking it. Brief? Any customer hits?
Matt: I'm seeing a sharp bump starting 09:10:47, error types: 502 from model validation and route mismatches. Latency also up. Quick tail of logs from router-edge-03 (09:11:10 - 09:12:30):
```
[09:11:12] route_decision: request_id=abc123 src=us-west-2 -> target=redwood-model-eu-v2 reason=route_table_match
[09:11:13] validation_error: request_id=def456 model_mismatch expected=redwood-model-us-small found=redwood-model-eu-v2
[09:12:01] rate_limit_check: allowed=true
```
Lee: Routing infra oncall — saw a config push at 09:09 from pipeline 'infra/route-updates' (change-id c7832). I'm pulling the diff now.
Olivia: Product reports increased errors from premium customers in us-west apps. Tickets starting ~09:11, severity high.
Anya: Hypothesis: the config push accidentally changed a rule specificity causing fallback to region-agnostic selector, hence routing opted for eu model. Mitigation plan: 1) revert route config to c7831 2) enable explicit fallback model pin for us-west (small-quant) 3) flush regional routing caches. Who can run the rollback?
Matt: I can trigger rollback. Running: `kubectl -n routing set configmap routes --from-file=routes-c7831.yaml`
Matt: DeployBot: rollback job queued (job-id rb-1755).
DeployBot: rb-1755 started on nodes routing-a,b,c.
Matt: rb-1755 applied. Confirming checksum matches c7831. Quick smoke: sending 50 synthetic requests -> 92% now routed to us-west small-quant, errors down. Still seeing ~3% misroutes.
Anya: Good. Keep working — that residual 3% is concerning. Likely edge cache or sticky session state. Lee can you check edge cache TTLs and any failed propagation?
Lee: Checking edge cache. I see some stale route entries with TTL=3600s from 08:55 that should have been refreshed. Looks like a propagation lag in route-propagator service around 09:08-09:10 (healthcheck flapped). Triggering cache flush on all edge nodes: `routectl flush --region us-west-2 --all`
Lee: Flush started... responses: edge-01 OK, edge-02 OK, edge-03 OK.
Matt: After flush, synthetic traffic shows 100% correct routing for 10/10 runs. Production sampling shows misroute rate down to 0.4% over last 5m.
Olivia: Confirmed product tickets show decreased errors. Customers A and B were the most vocal (both premium). Noting impact window 09:10-09:20 UTC; estimated affected requests ~12k.
Anya: Logging timeline for RCA: root push at 09:09 (c7832), propagation flap 09:08-09:10, misroute spike 09:11-09:17, mitigation rollback 09:14, cache flush 09:16, residual tail cleared by 09:18.
Matt: Pasting a few route decision API log lines for deeper analysis (sanitized):
```
# GET /v1/route_decision?id=abc123
{"timestamp":"2026-02-11T09:11:12Z","region":"us-west-2","selector":"region_agnostic","chosen":"redwood-model-eu-v2","match_score":0.87}
{"timestamp":"2026-02-11T09:11:45Z","region":"us-west-2","selector":"pinned_model_us","chosen":"redwood-model-us-small","match_score":0.99}
```
Anya: Hypothesis tracking: H1: config diff widened selector to region_agnostic (root cause). H2: route-propagator flap prevented timely refresh (contrib). H3: edge sticky sessions kept old decisions (minor). Current status: H1 supported by diff + logs; H2 supported by propagation metrics; H3 partially supported (stale cache entries).
Lee: I have the c7832 diff snippet that changed selector precedence: earlier 'region_specific' had higher priority, the change reordered to 'latency_then_priority' which inadvertently prefers lower-latency replicas regardless of region. Snippet: `- match: region_specific priority: 10
+ match: latency_then_priority priority: 8`
Anya: Customer impact note: premium tier experienced errors and degraded responses; we should offer outreach to top 5 affected customers. Olivia can own customer comms.
Olivia: Will draft comms. ETA 30m. Also capturing which customers: acct-13, acct-47, acct-92.
Matt: Action items captured: 1) revert config ordering (done) — owner: Lee 2) add automated route-propagator health check and rollback trigger — owner: Matt 3) reduce edge cache TTL to 60s for route entries — owner: Lee 4) add canary gating on route precedence changes — owner: Infra team.
Anya: Handoff: I'm moving this to routing RCA channel. Lee, you're on primary for post-incident investigation. Keep this thread updated with timeline + artifacts (diff, propagation metrics, edge cache dumps). I'll stay available for exec questions.
Lee: Ack. I'll export propagation metrics (prometheus query + CSV) and upload to the RCA doc.
IncidentBot: Incident mitigated at 09:18 UTC — status: mitigated.
Anya: Final quick note for runbook: when changing routing precedence, include a canary in a single region and monitor `route_mismatch_rate` and `propagator_ok` before full rollout.
Anya: Closing incident channel handoff. I'll create postmortem draft and assign reviewers.
Matt: Adding logs bundle location: s3://redwood-incident-logs/1755001234-routing-misroute/bundle.tar.gz
Olivia: I'll sync customer comms once the RCA doc has impact numbers.
Lee: Starting RCA deep-dive now. Expect initial findings in 24h.
Anya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
DeployBot: rollback rb-1755 completed on 09:15, duration 1m.
